# Bioeducation Journal

> > A peer-reviewed open-access academic journal published by Universitas Negeri Padang dedicated to biology education research and scholarship.

Bioeducation Journal is an academic publication platform hosted at Universitas Negeri Padang in Indonesia that publishes research articles in biology education. The journal operates under Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licensing and maintains rigorous peer review standards for all submissions.
